gloss: on the other hand; while; reverse side

definitions.gloss: on the other hand; while; at the same time
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce a contrasting aspect or perspective. Indicates that something has both a positive and negative side.
The opposite or back side of something.

examples.japanese: {便利|べんり}な{反面|はんめん}、{危険|きけん}もある。
examples.english: While convenient, there are also dangers.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優|やさ}しい{反面|はんめん}、{頑固|がんこ}な{面|めん}もある。
examples.english: While he is kind, he also has a stubborn side.

examples.japanese: {反面教師|はんめんきょうし}として{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: To learn from someone as a negative example.

examples.japanese: {物事|ものごと}の{反面|はんめん}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: To see the other side of things.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}の{反面|はんめん}にはリスクもある。
examples.english: On the flip side of success, there are also risks.

examples.japanese: {自由|じゆう}の{反面|はんめん}には{責任|せきにん}が{伴|ともな}うことを{忘|わす}れてはいけない。
examples.english: We must not forget that responsibility comes with the other side of freedom.

notes:
{反面|はんめん} presents contrasting aspects of the same thing — acknowledging that something has both a positive and a negative side.

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
- [i-adj/verb]{反面|はんめん}、〜: {便利|べんり}な{反面|はんめん}、{危険|きけん}もある (while convenient, there are dangers)
- [na-adj]な{反面|はんめん}、〜: {静|しず}かな{反面|はんめん}、{不便|ふべん}だ (while quiet, it's inconvenient)
- [noun]の{反面|はんめん}: {成功|せいこう}の{反面|はんめん} (the flip side of success)

COMMON EXPRESSION:
{反面教師|はんめんきょうし}: a negative example — someone whose mistakes you learn from. A very well-known compound.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {一方|いっぽう}で: 'on the other hand' (more neutral, can introduce unrelated contrast)
- その{反面|はんめん}: 'conversely' (used to introduce the contrasting point)
- {半面|はんめん}: 'half the face' — a different word with different kanji

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in writing and structured speech.
